_comment: Pinned external tools for the Spoken Audio Node's analysis worker (ADR-038).
Every entry was read from a distribution actually installed on the machine
that recorded it — the version from the tool's own output, the licence from
the path named in `readFrom`. Nothing here is taken from memory or from a
project page. A deployment on a different base image records its own values;
the worker refuses to run when a tool reports a version other than its pin,
so a stale file fails loudly rather than mislabelling a measurement.
Tools are spawned, never linked. For Praat that is a licensing requirement,
not a style choice: Praat is GPL-2+ and this service is BUSL-1.1.

licenseAttestation.license: GPL-2+ (files: *); GPL-3+ for the bundled external/glpk
licenseAttestation.note: Copyright 1990-2024 Paul Boersma and David Weenink, among others. Because the licence is GPL, Praat is invoked as a separate process and never linked into this service — the process boundary is what keeps the service's own licence intact. Re-read and re-record this attestation for any deployment that ships a different Praat build.

licenseAttestation.license: LGPL-2.1+ for the bulk of the distribution, with GPL-2+ components present in this build
licenseAttestation.note: The copyright file lists a mix of licences across components. ffmpeg is invoked as a separate process for the same reason Praat is. A deployment that enables additional GPL components should re-read this file and re-record the result.

licenseAttestation.license: LGPL-2.1+ for the bulk of the distribution, with GPL-2+ components present in this build
